meta.description:
Welcome to the advanced version of Emoji Simulator, made by TheComputerCrasher!
(For the simple version, head to ncase.me/sim, the original by Nicky Case.)

Here are some simple examples to help get you started:

🔥 Forest Fires (this one right here!)
← Click on the grid to add a fire, or click the "draw" button to change what you're adding to the sim!

💀 Epidemics
thecomputercrasher.github.io/emoji-sim-advanced/?s=sick

🌸 Conway's Game of Life
thecomputercrasher.github.io/emoji-sim-advanced/?s=conway

⚡ Wireworld
thecomputercrasher.github.io/emoji-sim-advanced/?s=wireworld

🔴 B-Z Chemical Spirals
thecomputercrasher.github.io/emoji-sim-advanced/?s=bz

🐹 Schelling's Segregation Model
thecomputercrasher.github.io/emoji-sim-advanced/?s=schelling

🦊 Predator-Prey Model
thecomputercrasher.github.io/emoji-sim-advanced/?s=prey

🏖️ Procedurally Generated Beaches
thecomputercrasher.github.io/emoji-sim-advanced/?s=beach

😐 Blank Sim (to make your own!)
thecomputercrasher.github.io/emoji-sim-advanced/?s=blank

And here are some more complicated examples once you've played around a bit:

🔼 Sierpinski's Triangle
thecomputercrasher.github.io/emoji-sim-advanced/?s=sierpinski

🪨 Rock-Paper-Scissors 7
thecomputercrasher.github.io/emoji-sim-advanced/?s=rps7

🧿 Creatures & Predators
thecomputercrasher.github.io/emoji-sim-advanced/?s=creatures

🐜 Langton's Ant
thecomputercrasher.github.io/emoji-sim-advanced/?s=ant

⏳ Sandboxels
thecomputercrasher.github.io/emoji-sim-advanced/?s=sandboxels

📈 Chou-Reggia Self-Replicator
nthecomputercrasher.github.io/emoji-sim-advanced/?s=chou-reggia


You can change a lot about these simulations: the text in these boxes, what emoji there are, the rules those emoji follow, how big the world is, and more!
You can save and share your sim using the buttons in the bottom right (you'll probably have to scroll down).

Have fun! 🎉
